request.description: Look up bridges, create ownerless wrappers and bridge tokens between Arc and Base using Circle CTS and CCTP infrastructure. External wallets sign blockchain transactions; resumable jobs track preparation, delivery and finality.
request.notes: OpenAPI: https://bridge-api.argosbot.io/openapi.json ; agent documentation: https://bridge-api.argosbot.io/llms.txt . Lookup requires a token query input. Job creation requires intent and external-wallet authorization from public POST /v1/authorization. Standard endpoints accept Circle Gateway USDC on Arc or direct Base USDC; /direct endpoints accept direct Arc or Base USDC. Standard prices: lookup 0.005 USDC, job 0.01 USDC; direct prices: lookup 0.007 USDC, job 0.012 USDC. Network gas and forwarding charges are separate. No wallet connection or paid bridge execution is required to inspect discovery metadata.
